demoBalances: Demo balances — the account pages below are placeholders and move no money.

deposit.intro: Bank transfer or payment gateway. Both stop at validation in this build.
deposit.demoBody: The form validated, but no request was sent and no balance moved. The live build posts makeBDepositV3 (bank) or makePDeposit (gateway) and waits for a reviewer.
deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.methodBankHint: Transfer to the account below, then upload the receipt.
deposit.methodGatewayHint: Please proceed to payment gateway to transfer the fund.
deposit.receiptHint: PNG or JPG. Must show the reference number.
deposit.pendingNotice: Requests are reviewed by a human in the demo build too — nothing is credited.
deposit.methodQrHint: Scan the QR with any supported banking app, or pay from your e-wallet.
deposit.atmTips: *For ATM deposit, you must submit the ATM receipt with {merchant} written by pen only to process your request
deposit.tutorialBody: The step-by-step tutorial video is not part of this demo build.
deposit.ruleApproval: Deposit requests are usually approved within 5 minutes — check the status under History → Deposit.
deposit.ruleFees: We do not charge any fees for deposits. However, some banks may charge their own transaction fees.
deposit.ruleAttention: *Attention: Please select another channel if your deposit request failed.
deposit.errorBody: Could not load the deposit methods.
deposit.emptyBody: No deposit method is currently available. Please try again later.
deposit.successBody: {amount} was added to your main wallet.

withdrawal.intro: The first withdrawal each month carries no fee; later ones do.
withdrawal.demoBody: Validated and stopped. The live build posts makeWithdrawalV2 and the request appears under Pending transactions.
withdrawal.placeholderNotice: Placeholder only: no request is created and no balance moves.
withdrawal.title: Withdrawal
withdrawal.noBankAccount: No verified bank account yet — an account must pass a document check before it can receive a payout.
withdrawal.feeNotice: First withdrawal each month is free; later ones carry a small fee.
withdrawal.successBody: {amount} was taken from your main wallet.

transfer.intro: Move money between the main wallet and a provider wallet before launching a title.

transfer.empty: There are no wallets to transfer between.
transfer.loadFailed: We could not load your wallets.
transfer.allConfirmBody: Are you sure to transfer all balance back to Main wallet?
transfer.allPartialBody: Moved {count} wallet balance(s) into {to}. Not moved (under maintenance): {skipped}.
